title: Safety Fine-Tuning at (Almost) No Cost: A Baseline for Vision Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates model safety using a new dataset (VLGuard) that specifically includes categories such as 'Discrimination' (based on race, sex, etc.) and 'Hateful Speech'. The authors identify and analyze harmful content in training data that includes 'derogatory comments about specific religions' and provide qualitative examples evaluating model responses to unethical requests and religious topics (e.g., a hostile critique of Christmas).
